title: Technical Product Owner
description:
**Title \- Technical Product Owner ( 4\-6 Yrs of Experience )** 




* Office Location \-202, 3rd Eye II, Opposite Parimal Garden, Panchavati Road, Chimanlal Girdharlal Rd, Ahmedabad, Gujarat 380009
* Duration \& Type of Employment \- Full Time
* Work Style \- Hybrid
* In\-office days \- 3 days a week
* Relocation \- Candidate must be willing to relocate to Ahmedabad, GJ, with reasonable notice.
   

**Immediate Joiner preferable**


 Requirements
   

  


**Key Responsibilities** 
  




* Product Strategy \& Roadmap: Define and manage product vision, strategy, and roadmap with stakeholders, keeping alignment with business objectives and customer needs.
* Technical Leadership: Partner hands\-on with architects and engineers. Understanding the system architecture deeply enough to guide technical decisions, pressure\-test feasibility, and ensure features are scalable and maintainable, while translating between business intent and technical execution.
* Backlog Management: Own the product backlog and prioritize features, enhancements, and technical debt against business goals and timelines.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with engineering, design, and QA to ensure requirements are clearly communicated and delivered efficiently.
* Stakeholder Communication: Regularly engage stakeholders to gather feedback, manage expectations, and report on progress.
* Customer\-Centric Focus: Collect customer feedback, analyze market trends, and make data\-driven decisions to improve the product.
* Agile Delivery: Apply Agile practices (Scrum/Kanban) to manage development cycles, ensuring timely, high\-quality releases.
* Quality Assurance: Work with QA to ensure the product meets high standards of quality and performance through thorough testing.



**Qualifications** 
  




* Experience: 3\+ years as a Technical Product Owner (or equivalent) on technically complex products.
* Technical Depth: Able to get into the thick of the technology; comfortable discussing system architecture, APIs, cloud/infrastructure, and data with architects and developers, and using that understanding to shape product decisions. Prior hands\-on or engineering\-adjacent experience is a strong plus.
* Feasibility \& Constraints: Understands the software development lifecycle well enough to reason about development constraints, integration points, and delivery risk.
* DevOps Awareness: Familiarity with modern DevOps and delivery practices (CI/CD, deployment, monitoring) are good to have.
* Agile Knowledge: Strong experience working in Agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban).
* Product Management: Skilled at defining roadmaps, managing backlogs, and writing clear user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Stakeholder Management: Strong communication and interpersonal skills to manage cross\-functional teams and stakeholders.
* Problem Solving: Able to prioritise and make quick, informed decisions balancing technical feasibility with business impact.
* Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (preferred).


 Benefits
   

  


 BENEFITS
   

  

 \-Hybrid Working Culture
   





 \-Amazing Perks \& Medical Benefits
   





 \-5 Days Working
   





 \-Mentorship Programs \& Certification Courses
   





 \-Flexible work arrangements
   





 \-Free drinks, fridge and snacks
   





 \-Competitive Salary \& recognitions

title: Technical Product Manager
description:
**About the Role** 




 As a
 **Product Manager – AI \& EdTech Platform** 
 , you will be responsible for building our EdTech product
 **from the ground up** 
 .
 



 This is a
 **0\-to\-1 product ownership role** 
 . You will work closely with leadership, engineering, design, content, and business teams to define the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and execution.
 



  





**The ideal candidate will have:** 



* Proven experience
 **building and launching digital products from scratch**
* Strong experience in
 **AI/GenAI product development**
* A solid understanding of
 **EdTech and digital learning platforms**
* The ability to take
 **end\-to\-end ownership** 
 of a product
* Strong business, technical, analytical, and problem\-solving skills



**EdTech industry experience is strongly preferred and will be considered a significant advantage.** 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 1\. Product Strategy \& Vision
 


* Define and own the
 **product vision, strategy, and roadmap** 
 for the EdTech platform.
* Translate business objectives and customer needs into clear product strategies and priorities.
* Conduct market, competitor, and user research to identify product opportunities and differentiation.
* Define the product's value proposition, positioning, and long\-term growth strategy.
* Establish product goals, KPIs, and success metrics in collaboration with leadership.



  





 2\. 0\-to\-1 Product Development
 


* Own the complete product lifecycle from
 **ideation, discovery, and validation to development, launch, and continuous improvement** 
 .
* Define product requirements, user stories, workflows, and acceptance criteria.
* Work closely with UI/UX designers to create intuitive and engaging user experiences.
* Collaborate with engineering teams throughout the development lifecycle to ensure successful product delivery.
* Prioritize features based on
 **business impact, customer value, technical feasibility, and strategic priorities** 
 .
* Manage and maintain the product backlog.
* Coordinate product releases and support successful go\-to\-market execution.



  





 3\. AI \& GenAI Product Development
 


* Identify opportunities to integrate
 **AI and Generative AI** 
 into the EdTech platform.
* Work with engineering and AI teams to define and develop AI\-powered product features.
* Understand the capabilities and limitations of
 **LLMs, RAG, AI agents, prompt engineering, and AI\-driven automation** 
 .
* Translate AI capabilities into practical product features that solve real customer and learner problems.
* Define requirements for AI\-powered:
* Personalization
* Content generation
* Recommendations
* Assessments
* Learning assistance
* Automation
* Monitor AI product performance and continuously improve the user experience using data and feedback.



  





 4\. EdTech Product Development
 


* Develop features that improve
 **learning engagement, course discovery, content consumption, assessments, and learner outcomes** 
 .
* Understand different learner journeys and identify opportunities to personalize the learning experience.
* Work closely with content and subject\-matter teams to ensure the platform effectively supports educational and professional learning content.
* Use learner behavior and product analytics to improve
 **engagement, retention, and course completion** 
 .
* Stay updated on emerging
 **EdTech, AI\-powered learning, and digital education trends** 
 .



  





 5\. User \& Market Research
 


* Conduct user interviews, surveys, feedback sessions, and usability studies.
* Identify customer and learner pain points and translate them into product opportunities.
* Analyze user behavior, product analytics, and market trends to identify areas for improvement.
* Validate product assumptions and concepts before significant development investment.
* Continuously gather and incorporate customer feedback into the product roadmap.



  





 6\. Cross\-Functional Collaboration
 


* Act as the bridge between
 **business, technology, design, content, and other stakeholders** 
 .
* Work closely with Engineering, Design, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Content teams.
* Clearly communicate product priorities, roadmap, requirements, and progress.
* Drive alignment across teams and ensure timely execution of product initiatives.
* Present product strategy, progress, and insights to leadership.



  





 7\. Product Analytics \& Optimization
 


* Define and monitor key product metrics and KPIs.
* Use data to make informed product and prioritization decisions.
* Track metrics such as:
* Product adoption
* User engagement
* Retention
* Conversion
* Course completion
* Learner satisfaction
* Conduct A/B testing and product experimentation where appropriate.
* Continuously optimize the platform based on
 **data, user behavior, and feedback** 
 .



  





**Required Qualifications** 



* **5\+ years of experience in Product Management** 
 , preferably with digital, SaaS, or technology products.
* Proven experience
 **building and launching products from 0\-to\-1** 
 .
* Demonstrated ownership of the complete product lifecycle from
 **ideation through launch and post\-launch optimization** 
 .
* Strong understanding of
 **AI/GenAI and AI\-powered product development** 
 .
* Experience working closely with
 **engineering and UI/UX teams** 
 .
* Strong understanding of:
* Product discovery
* User research
* Product strategy
* Roadmapping
* Feature prioritization
* Product analytics
* Agile/Scrum methodologies
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Ability to work independently and take

* **EdTech industry experience is strongly preferred.**
* Experience building:

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
**Job Description**
 The Oracle Health
 **Medication Administration** 
 team is responsible for delivering solutions that help clinicians safely and efficiently administer medications across acute, ambulatory, and specialty care settings. Medication administration is one of the most critical moments in the care delivery process, directly impacting patient safety, clinical outcomes, regulatory compliance, operational efficiency, and clinician experience.
   

  

 Our mission is to support and evolve medication administration workflows through intuitive, reliable, and highly integrated solutions that reduce cognitive burden, streamline nursing workflows, and improve patient safety. This includes maintaining existing medication administration capabilities that customers depend on today, while also modernizing traditional workflows through interoperability, mobile experiences, barcode medication administration, clinical decision support, workflow optimization, and emerging AI\-enabled capabilities.
   

  

 We are seeking a
 **Senior Product Manager** 
 to help manage, enhance, and modernize medication administration capabilities within Oracle Health’s Electronic Health Record. In this role, you will balance support for existing and legacy product capabilities with the development of new workflows, modernization initiatives, and future\-state medication administration experiences.
   

  

 You will partner closely with nursing leaders, pharmacists, physicians, customers, engineering teams, UX designers, clinical informaticists, quality, regulatory, consulting, and customer\-facing teams to deliver solutions that improve the safety, efficiency, usability, and reliability of medication administration workflows.
   

  

 You will be responsible for understanding customer needs, defining product requirements, prioritizing investments, supporting roadmap execution, and guiding product development from concept through delivery and adoption. This role requires a product manager who can operate across current\-state product support, customer commitments, regulatory and safety expectations, technical modernization, and future\-state product innovation.
   

  

 Your work will directly impact clinicians caring for patients every day while helping Oracle Health advance the next generation of medication management.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Product Strategy, Roadmap, and Portfolio Execution: Contribute to the strategic direction and roadmap for medication administration capabilities across the Oracle Health platform. Balance enhancement requests, customer commitments, regulatory needs, technical debt, customer feedback, defects, lifecycle considerations, and modernization investments across both existing and future\-state product capabilities.
* Existing Product Support and Lifecycle Management: Support the ongoing evolution of existing and legacy medication administration capabilities that are currently used by Oracle Health customers. Evaluate customer issues, workflow gaps, adoption barriers, technical constraints, and lifecycle needs to inform prioritization, sustainment decisions, modernization plans, and customer communication.
* Product Requirements and Feature Definition: Translate customer needs, clinical workflow requirements, regulatory expectations, modernization priorities, and market opportunities into clear product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and workflow documentation. Partner closely with engineering and UX teams throughout the development lifecycle to ensure requirements are actionable, testable, and aligned to product intent.
* Clinical Workflow Expertise: Develop deep understanding of medication administration workflows, including barcode medication administration, medication scanning, medication scheduling, infusion management, documentation, exception handling, medication safety checks, and clinical communication. Ensure solutions align with real\-world nursing practice across both current customer workflows and future\-state product experiences.
* Customer and User Engagement: Engage with customers, external stakeholders, and internal stakeholders to understand workflow challenges, ensure product capabilities align with customer needs, gather feedback, and support adoption. Act as the voice of the customer while balancing individual customer needs with scalable product direction.
* Patient Safety and Quality Focus: Champion patient safety by identifying opportunities to reduce medication errors, improve compliance with medication administration policies, strengthen documentation quality, and enhance decision support during medication administration workflows. Ensure product decisions appropriately account for clinical risk, usability, reliability, and safety in high\-stakes care settings.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Partner with engineering, UX, clinical informatics, interoperability, quality assurance, regulatory, consulting, support, customer success, and customer\-facing teams to deliver high\-quality solutions that meet customer and market needs. Drive alignment across stakeholders when priorities, ownership, dependencies, or tradeoffs are unclear.
* Workflow Modernization and Innovation: Drive modernization initiatives focused on improving usability, mobility, automation, workflow efficiency, and product scalability. Evaluate emerging technologies, including AI and intelligent automation, to identify opportunities that create measurable value for clinicians while maintaining trust, safety, and operational readiness.
* Regulatory and Compliance Alignment: Ensure product capabilities support applicable healthcare regulations, accreditation standards, medication safety practices, privacy, security, and documentation requirements. Partner with regulatory, quality, clinical safety, and engineering stakeholders to ensure both existing and new capabilities remain aligned with evolving compliance expectations.
* Product Delivery, Release Readiness, and Adoption: Support release planning, dependency tracking, customer readiness, documentation, training, enablement, and adoption strategies. Measure outcomes and continuously improve products based on customer feedback, support trends, usage data, workflow observations, and product performance metrics.
* Market and Industry Awareness: Maintain awareness of healthcare industry trends, nursing informatics practices, medication safety initiatives, competitor offerings, interoperability standards, and evolving technology expectations. Use market and customer insights to inform roadmap decisions, modernization priorities, and investment recommendations.


**Qualifications**
 Career Level \- IC3
   

  

**About Us**
 Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life\-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
   

  

 True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
   

  

 We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation\-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1\-888\-404\-2494 in the United States.
   

  

 Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.
